summary: Measured on the wheel's link, the one multi-shot effect (lib/search's Choice, op choose) has two providers (pick_first search:87, backtrack search:129) and nothing references either of them or choose. abort is performed only inside those two unused handlers. The wheel's whole TIME axis is hand-written: 12 graph_push_checkpoint references in 5 modules (infer 3, mentl 3, query 4, synth_proposer 1, search 1), 15 graph_rollback and 2 graph_commit_checkpoint. Whether multi-shot is the right form depends on where the choice stands. When the choice is at the ROOT of an extent (Mycroft's plain/general rounds, the gradient's candidate proofs), a continuation buys nothing. The right form there is one extent install, the arena's sibling: it adds the graph-trail and world faces to the heap face the arena already gives. All four fork triples already sit inside `~> arena`. Deleting the trail ops from the program-facing surface would make the hand bracket unsayable, as Arena·P2 did for heap_reset. When the choice is INSIDE a computation (the ??-fan's term cell, today whole-candidate enumeration then filter, re-installing 13 handlers per candidate), multi-shot is the right form (PLAN §11.1). Each resumption becomes a trail segment if C×A's 'each resumption is an arena of its own' is extended to the trail. That form depends on capture at every position (#159), ledger state kept in the trail, and (arena, offset) handles. Once it lands, the self-compile exercises band B and m2 == m3 covers it. The four rename brackets in query.mn are not speculation: `where` writes the graph under a handler whose comment says it is read-only. lib/combinators' race returns its first argument: its tiebreak reads constant stubs and its Branch effect has no provider. lib/search is welded to the compiler's trail and still carries the `Some(value) => value` shape that AN-1 refused in its own crucible. The monotone fixpoints want a semi-naive `<~` over the delta, not multi-shot. The prelude's find/any/all/take keep walking after the answer is fixed, where an AN-2 abandoning arm would stop; whether a mixed arm lowers without a record is unmeasured. No tutorial teaches the TIME axis. Comments describing deleted or never-built TIME machinery: 7 of 9 'trial' sites read, the synth header's MultiShot claims, src/oracle.mn, the 'eleven-handler' bracket that installs 13.

findings.title: The wheel never performs a multi-shot op: its whole TIME axis is hand-rolled, so the fixpoint oracle never exercises band B
findings.class_size: 1 multi-shot op on the wheel's link (choose), 2 providers, 0 references to choose or to either provider. abort is performed at 2 sites, both inside those unused handlers; catch_abort is referenced once, inside the same unused code. Against that: 12 graph_push_checkpoint, 15 graph_rollback and 2 graph_commit_checkpoint references in 5 modules.
findings.current: Every speculation, retry and candidate loop in the compiler is a hand bracket over the graph trail. RESIDUE 12825-12837 says choose is 'the only MultiShot family on the wheel', and tests/native-cont/README.md says 'the wheel itself has no multi-shot handler'. The crucible's own header (mn-backtrack-full.mn:5-7) says 'backtrack is DEAD CODE in the wheel, so no wheel gate can see it'.
findings.ideal: Use multi-shot where the disjunction is interior: the ??-fan's term cell (S8). Use the extent install where the choice is at the root (S2, S3). Once the fan performs choose, the self-compile runs continuation reification, the re-drive, C×A's suspended arenas and per-resumption segments, and m2 == m3 covers the TIME axis instead of crucibles alone.
findings.law: PLAN §4④: search, sampling, backtracking and durable execution are one primitive. §11 tripwire 3: the board's oracles are blind to what the wheel never does. CLAUDE.md: Mentl solves Mentl.
findings.evidence: refs of choose → '0 reference(s)'. provider of choose → 'pick_first at search:87', 'backtrack at search:129'. refs of backtrack / pick_first → '0 reference(s)'. refs of abort → search:87:45, search:131:7. provider of abort → 'catch_abort at own:33'. variants Synth → 'synth_propose/2'. The refs counts are listed in commands.
findings.gate: S2's surface deletion makes the hand bracket unsayable. A board FLOOR (at least 1 perform of a ->* op in the wheel's emitted reach, read by the resume-cardinality facet in V3) keeps the oracle covering band B.

findings.title: Twelve hand-written speculation brackets: the arena is the heap face of one extent whose graph-trail and world faces are still bracketed by hand beside it
findings.class_size: 12 graph_push_checkpoint references in 5 modules (infer 3, mentl 3, query 4, synth_proposer 1, search 1); 15 graph_rollback; 2 graph_commit_checkpoint. 4 of world_top's 5 references are the fork triple; the fifth is world_key at memory:189. All 4 triples already sit inside `~> arena`.
findings.current: Each fork site writes `let cp = graph_push_checkpoint(); let w = world_top(); <body>; graph_rollback(cp); world_restore(w)` inside `{…} ~> arena`. The synth fan also reads graph_written_since(cp, below) before the rollback and replays branch_join after world_restore. The order is restated as prose at the site (synth_proposer:1051: 'THE ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. The world is restored before the facts are replayed'). The push arm (graph:467-489) snapshots {comment_refs, next, span_index, spine, spine_open, trail, trail_len}, and a rollback walks the inverse log.
findings.ideal:
One extent install with three faces, lowered the way LArena is.
- `(body) ~> speculate` opens a trail segment and a world mark beside the arena's heap mark.
- Its exit rewinds the trail, restores the world, and reclaims the heap except what the publication reaches: the body's value (moved by the arena's leaves), the cells the segment wrote (handed out before the rewind), and the facts branch_join replays after the world restore. The order is written once, at the exit.
- A commit exit keeps the segment (Mycroft's accept).
- Extend C×A's rule from heap to trail: a choose inside a speculate extent suspends its segment, and every resumption opens a fresh one. Facts proven before the choice stay visible to every resumption, which is §11.1's shared prefix, and no policy handler touches a checkpoint.
- Then delete graph_push_checkpoint, graph_rollback, graph_commit_checkpoint, world_top and world_restore from the program-facing effect surface.

Every one of the 12 sites has a destination: Mycroft, the gradient and the fan go to the extent (S3, S8); query's four go to a naming read (S4); search goes to an independent user library (S6).
findings.law: Carried-Truth: one fact, 'this extent's writes die at its exit except its publication', written 12 times. PLAN §7 Arena·P2: 'heap_reset is deleted from Alloc, so a rewind that drops a region something older still points into is unsayable, and the raw brackets that leaned on a convention … are arenas'. §11.1: branches are trail segments over one graph.
findings.evidence: The refs answers listed in commands. The bracket bodies were read at the listed lines. mentl:329 and the synth_proposer:1094 block end in `} ~> arena`.
findings.gate: Unsayability by effect surface: when only the speculate install's lowering performs the trail and world ops, a hand bracket does not judge (the Arena·P2 precedent). Until then, a census shape for a trail op performed outside that lowering, board-bounded at the measured 12 and falling to 0.

findings.title: Mycroft's three rounds are a hand-unrolled backtracking search with four copies of the fallback; multi-shot is NOT its form
findings.class_size: 1 function with 3 checkpoints, 6 rollbacks, 2 commits and 4 copies of `infer_fn(name, params, body_node, ret_ann, effs, handle, span, false)`. 2 capture handlers do one job (poly_capture and diag_branch), and 2 replay paths do one job (`each(replay_report, held)` and branch_join).
findings.current: Round 1 judges plain under poly_capture. On refusal it rolls back and judges under the general assumption, then rechecks under the result scheme. Any failure rolls back and re-runs plain, reporting. The accept path is `graph_commit_checkpoint(cp3); each(replay_report, held3)`. K = 3 is a constant, and the OPEN Hβ.infer.mycroft-recheck-one-round-short (RESIDUE 3337-3356) records it one round short on a measured shape: 'the general form is iterate-to-fixpoint (compare round n+1 against round n, bounded by K)'.
findings.ideal: The alternatives (assume plain, assume general) sit at the extent's root, so a continuation buys nothing. Use two thunks under S2's speculate extent with a commit-on-success exit. Make the general branch's recheck a `<~` over the published scheme until two rounds agree: the open peer's own form, with K a bound and not the count. Write the reporting plain re-run once, as the fallback. diag_branch is the one capture handler and poly_capture is deleted; the commit exit replays held reports where branch_join already replays a branch's.
findings.law: CLAUDE.md: census-not-moles, and the second workaround is the stop. Anchor 6: cycles are `<~`. Choice at an extent's root is a closure, not a continuation.
findings.evidence: src/infer.mn:2723-2816, read this session. The refs answers place 3 pushes, 6 rollbacks and 2 commits inside it. The poly_capture doc reads '(the diag_branch precedent)'. RESIDUE 3337-3356.
findings.gate: The open peer's one-round-short shape as a RED-first fixture that goes green under the `<~` form. S2's surface deletion refuses a re-grown ladder.

findings.title: lib/search.mn, the user's search library, is welded to the compiler's graph trail and still carries the shape AN-1 refused in its own crucible
findings.class_size: 2 handlers and 1 combinator. 2 performs of compiler-graph ops in a user library. 1 checkpoint is pushed per successful choose and never popped. 3 stale citations: src/oracle.mn does not exist, there is no ChoiceFork Reason, and catch_abort is cited at own:31 while the medium places it at own:33.
findings.current:
backtrack performs graph_push_checkpoint (GraphRead) and graph_rollback (GraphWrite), which only the compiler's graph_handler answers. A user program installing `~> backtrack` therefore needs the compiler's graph handler at its root. The crucible that proves backtracking (mn-backtrack-full.mn) imports nothing and writes its own `bt` / `twac` / `my_catch` with no checkpoint.

On success the pushed checkpoint stays on the stack, so every later graph write is journaled.

try_with_abort_catch unwraps `Some(value) => value`, the shape the crucible records AN-1 refusing at its install ('until then twac answered `value` — an Int wearing an Option's type … the judgment refuses both now (`Int vs Option(t)` at the install)'), rewritten there to `found => found`. The library judges clean only because nothing installs it, and its resume sits in a nested fn (S2's open Hβ.infer.resume-in-a-called-fn-has-no-arm-types).

The two handlers of one effect answer different types (Option(a) and a), so swapping them is not a handler swap.

Every user search program also pays a root `~> my_catch` that never fires (mn-backtrack-full.mn:69-79, Hβ.continuations.remainder-row-charged-at-perform-site).
findings.ideal:
A Choice library independent of the compiler, where every policy is a handler:
- `first`: each option's resumption under catch_abort; an exhausted list abandons per AN-2 instead of performing a second effect.
- `all`: one resumption per option, results collected.
- `best(cost)`, `count`, `sample(weights)`.
- `persisted`: lib/persist under the resumption.

Each resumption is isolated by S2's segment-per-resumption rule, so no policy touches a trail. The library adopts the crucible's `found => found`, and pick_first and first then answer one type.
findings.law: §4④: exploration policy is a handler swap. AN-1: an arm's value is the install's value. Layering: a user library must not perform the compiler's GraphRead/GraphWrite.
findings.evidence:
mentl check lib/search.mn → exit 0. mentl where lib/search.mn backtrack → 'answers Option(a)'. pick_first → 'answers a'. try_with_abort_catch → 'try_fn : () -> Option(a)', '-> a'. provider of abort → 'catch_abort at own:33'. lib/search.mn and mn-backtrack-full.mn read whole.

findings.title: The ??-fan enumerates whole candidates and then filters, under 13 handler installs per candidate. This is the one place in the wheel where multi-shot IS the form
findings.class_size: 1 fan. Every candidate is built whole (enumerate_vocabulary_calls / enumerate_typed), then judged in its own segment under 13 handler installs (intern_view, diag_branch, mutate_sink, env_handler, lookup_ty_graph, verify_ledger, region_tracker, affine_ledger, resume_summaries_ctx, fresh_for_inference, infer_ctx, store_ages, row_gate). findings.title: The prelude's early-exit operations keep walking after the answer is fixed; AN-2's abandoning arm is their form
findings.current: find_handler stores Some(elem) and then resumes every remaining element (`Some(_) => resume()`). any/all resume after found/ok is fixed. take_collector resumes after `remaining` reaches 0. So find's cost is the list, not the position of the match. prelude:157-162 justifies the fused single-handler design with 'arm-internal performs to reach outer handlers — not yet substrate', which SYNTAX §«A handler is exhaustive» now documents as substrate: a forwarding arm's perform resolves to the enclosing handler (L5).
findings.ideal: The arm that knows the answer abandons: `yield(e) => if pred(e) { Some(e) } else { resume() }`. The install answers Some(e) and the dead continuation unwinds through the world restore (AN-2, real since 2026-10-03). Chained transformer handlers become expressible as forwarding arms.
findings.law: PLAN §5.O: the cost of an operation is the size of the answer it was asked for. SYNTAX §«Resume discipline»: Abandon.
findings.evidence:
lib/prelude.mn:106-379 read. mentl where lib/prelude.mn find_handler → 'answers a at prelude:289'.

findings.title: The TIME ops are split across GraphRead and GraphWrite, and the checkpoint is an Int
sites: graph write arms (`let j = journaling(checkpoint_stack); if !j { graph_mutated(epoch, m) }`)
findings.class_size: 4 trail ops in 2 effects (push and written_since are reads; rollback and commit are writes); 1 Int token.
findings.current: graph_push_checkpoint is a GraphRead op (where: 'GraphRead op — resume Int ->1 answer'), yet it pushes graph_handler's checkpoint stack and switches every later write to journaled and silenced. A `!GraphWrite` function can change how every subsequent write behaves, and the checkpoint is a bare Int (drift 8).
findings.ideal: Subsumed by S2: the trail ops leave the program-facing surface and the speculate extent is their only performer. If a typed handle is needed at all, it is a Segment value the extent owns, never an Int.
findings.law: The negation is provable (§0 property 2) only if a read op is a read. Drift 8.
findings.evidence: mentl where src/main.mn graph_push_checkpoint. variants GraphWrite lists graph_rollback/1 and graph_commit_checkpoint/1. types.mn and graph.mn read at the listed lines.

findings.title: The user-facing TIME axis is untaught and undemonstrated: no tutorial, and no multi-shot use in ml, test, dsp or Pulse
findings.class_size: 10 tutorials, 0 multi-shot handlers. 0 Choice performs in the doc answers for lib/ml, lib/test, lib/dsp (processors, spectral, clock, feedback) and examples/pulse/render.
findings.current: The course covers the eight primitives; tutorial 02's only handler is a one-shot counter. Autodiff is correctly a projection (RESIDUE 7857-7859 retracts autodiff-as-multishot). Pulse's GRADIENT.md: 'The program was written directly, without `??` holes … the holes M2 measures need a writer who does not already know them'. clock_record and clock_replay are trace record/replay.
findings.ideal:
Multi-shot's user homes are discrete choice:
- A `sample(dist)` op in lib/ml whose handlers are exact enumeration (resume per support point, weights summed), importance sampling and MCMC.
- Pulse's discrete design decisions (a voice's waveform, a filter's kind, a note sequence) as choose points under `~> best(score)`, judged by the frontier's Goertzel oracle.
- A long render made resumable through persist, since C×A keeps a suspended arena's region.
- lib/test property tests as choose under an exhaustive small-scope handler, with shrinking as `first` over smaller inputs.
- A TIME tutorial: a generator, a backtracking puzzle, a resumable render.

clock_record and clock_replay stay as testing handlers; durable execution is the persisted continuation, not a replayed trace.
findings.law: PLAN §11.3 leg 3: the surface IS the course. §2: multi-shot is one of the three axes of the read. §4④.
findings.evidence: The scratchpad doc answers listed in commands, read whole. RESIDUE 7857-7859. GRADIENT.md.
findings.gate: Each new handler lands with a battery fixture or frontier leg judging its answer. The tutorial runs through the same battery its siblings do.

root_designs: R1 · ONE EXTENT, THREE FACES. `(body) ~> arena` already reclaims the heap face. Add the graph-trail face and the world face as one install the lowering replaces: `~> speculate`, whose exit rewinds, restores and reclaims except its publication (the value, the written cells, the replayed facts), plus a commit exit. Extend C×A's 'each resumption is an arena of its own' to the trail, so each resumption is a segment of its own and prefix facts are shared. Delete the trail and world ops from the program-facing surface, as Arena·P2 deleted heap_reset. This deletes the 4 fork triples, Mycroft's ladder and its 3 extra fallback copies, poly_capture, and backtrack's compiler coupling, and writes the synth fan's order law once.

R2 · CHOICE WHERE THE DISJUNCTION STANDS. A choice at an extent's root (Mycroft, the gradient's candidate lists) is a list of thunks under R1 and costs no continuation. A choice inside a computation (the ??-fan's term cell) is `choose` under a policy handler (all-proven / first / ask / persisted / threaded), each resumption an R1 segment. Its dependencies are capture at every position (#159), ledger state in the trail (5.5's banks as columns), and (arena, offset) handles. When it lands, the self-compile exercises band B and m2 == m3 covers it.
R3 · PROJECTIONS NEVER WRITE. Naming free type variables is a render-context read, and `!GraphWrite + !RowWrite` declared on the projection family is armed by E_EffectMismatch.

R4 · MONOTONE FIXPOINTS AS `<~` OVER THE DELTA. Semi-naive iteration over the reverse edge and the graph_mutated (handle, prior) delta every handler discards today. Iterate's early exits abandon (AN-2), with a TailOrAbandon grade if a mixed arm reifies today.

R5 · THE USER'S TIME LIBRARY. lib/search becomes independent of the compiler: Choice with first / all / best / count / sample / persisted, abandoning arms as dead-ends, and one answer type per policy. lib/combinators is deleted into verdict_of / VAsk. A per-branch-state fixture fixes the semantics first. Add a TIME tutorial and property testing in lib/test.
verb_gaps: V1 · `mentl query src/main.mn decls` answers 8004 bare addresses, no names or kinds, after more than 5 minutes; it cannot answer a census by declaration kind (which decls are handlers, which are effect ops).
V2 · `mentl query <entry> census` with no shape answers 'error: unknown query: census' instead of the roster; the shape names had to be read out of pipeline.mn's census_shape_of.

V3 · No facet lists ops by inferred resume cardinality across a link (every ->* op, every handler that resumes more than once, every held resume). `where` gives one op's badge, and 'choose is the only MultiShot family' exists only as RESIDUE prose.
V4 · No facet pairs a checkpoint with its rollback or commit, or finds an unpaired one (backtrack's success-path push). `refs of` returns sites without the bracket that contains them.
V5 · `prose NEEDLE` answers addresses without the comment text: classifying 20 'trial' sites took 20 reads where one answer carrying the lines would do.
V6 · `mentl check` on a library is silent when a declared effect has no provider anywhere in its link (lib/combinators' Branch: exit 0, no output).
V7 · No census shape for Option-threaded early exit (the Abort costume) or for an Iterate arm that resumes after its answer is fixed (find_handler's `Some(_) => resume()`).

V8 · `refs of` takes one name per whole-wheel judgment (30-55 s each under load); the TIME-op family (push, rollback, commit, world_top, world_restore, written_since) needed 5 judgments where one multi-name question would do.
